masthead.purpose: Product name, centred, Old Standard TT bold.

letter.purpose: Uppercase characters inside the letter squares.

body.purpose: Base interface text and each partial-match word.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked label: field label, Your letters, section title, partial group heading. Counter, footer and group count use the same size untracked.

word-exact.purpose: Each exact match on the results page; bold lowercase.

button-secondary.purpose: Show partial matches, Show more, Cancel.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Easing for the letter entry animation.

motion.name: pencil-in
motion.purpose: A typed letter settling into its square. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: Caret in the active square. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Letter Squares
components.description: Row of ruled squares drawn over the real input; the active one carries the pencil caret.
components.html: PLE
components.css: .ds-squares { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 3rem); padding: 0 2px 2px 0; } .ds-sq { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; margin: 0 -2px -2px 0; background: var(--cell, #f2f3f1); color: var(--ink, #121413); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121413); font: 700 1.75rem/1 var(--sans, 'Libre Franklin Variable', Arial, sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-active { z-index: 1; background: var(--mark, #cfd8f0); outline: 3px solid var(--pencil, #2748a8); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 7px; top: 20%; bottom: 20%; width: 2px; background: var(--pencil, #2748a8); }

components.name: Solve Button
components.css: .ds-btn-solve { display: block; width: 100%; height: 4rem; background: var(--ink, #121413); color: var(--on-ink, #e3e5e2); border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 700 1.125rem/1 var(--sans, 'Libre Franklin Variable', Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-solve:hover { background: var(--pencil, #2748a8); color: var(--paper, #e3e5e2); } .ds-btn-solve:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pencil, #2748a8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-solve:active { translate: 0 1px; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Circular icon button that switches light and dark.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Dark mode"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 3.5a8.5 8.5 0 0 0 0 17z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; display: grid; place-items: center; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ink, #121413); cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background: var(--mark, #cfd8f0); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pencil, #2748a8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Example Link
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-block; padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem; color: var(--pencil, #2748a8); font: 700 0.9375rem/1.5 var(--sans, 'Libre Franklin Variable', Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pencil, #2748a8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Centred serif name over a muted descriptor, closed by a 4px double rule.
components.css: .ds-mast { border-bottom: 4px double var(--ink, #121413); padding-bottom: 0.75rem; text-align: center; } .ds-mast-name { font: 700 3rem/1 var(--display, 'Old Standard TT', 'Times New Roman', serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-mast-sub { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #464b48); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined ink button for Show partial matches, Show more and Cancel; Solve stays the only reversed plate.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: block; width: 100%; height: 3.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #121413); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121413); border-radius: 0; font: 700 0.9375rem/1 var(--sans, 'Libre Franklin Variable', Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink, #121413); color: var(--on-ink, #e3e5e2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pencil, #2748a8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { translate: 0 1px; }

components.name: Icon Button (Edit)
components.description: Circular icon-only button sharing the theme toggle's rules; the drawn pencil opens edit mode.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Edit letters"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 20l1.2-4.4L16.6 4.2a2 2 0 0 1 2.8 0l.4.4a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.8L8.4 18.8z"/><path d="M14.5 6.3l3.2 3.2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; display: grid; place-items: center; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--ink, #121413); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--mark, #cfd8f0); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pencil, #2748a8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: New Search Link
components.description: Pencil-blue underlined link back to the home page at the top of results.
components.css: .ds-back { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--pencil, #2748a8); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pencil, #2748a8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Exact-Match List
components.description: Section title over a 2px ink rule, then large bold lowercase words on 1px ink rules.
components.css: .ds-title { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #121413); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-exact-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-exact-list li { padding: 0.625rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #121413); font: 700 2rem/1.2 var(--sans, 'Libre Franklin Variable', Arial, sans-serif); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Partial Group
components.description: Heading with muted tabular word count over a 2px rule, then body words in columns with a 1px column rule.
components.css: .ds-group-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #121413); } .ds-group-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-count { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted, #464b48); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-words { list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; column-width: 9rem; column-gap: 1.25rem; column-rule: 1px solid var(--muted, #464b48); } .ds-words li { break-inside: avoid; padding: 0.25rem 0; font-size: 1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
The surface reads as a newspaper puzzle column printed in graphite on cool grey newsprint. A serif masthead sits over a double rule, the input is a row of ruled boxes like a crossword answer grid, and the only colour is a single pencil blue that marks where you are and what you can act on. Results continue the page: the same squares show the letters you hold, and the words found are set as ruled rows and columns like an answer key. It is built phone-first, one column, and quiet enough to be read in one glance mid-puzzle.

Ink-on-paper contrast does the work. There are no shadows, no radii, no gradients and no imagery; structure comes from 2px ink borders, 2px section rules, 1px list rules, a 4px double masthead rule and a 1px footer rule. The dark theme is the same page printed in reverse: warm-white ink on near-black paper, with the pencil blue lifted to a pale tint.
keyCharacteristics: Cool grey paper, near-black ink, one blue accent used only for focus, hover and links.
Hairline-to-2px ink rules and square corners throughout; no shadows.
Serif (Old Standard TT) for the masthead and headline only; everything else is sans (Libre Franklin).
Letters you hold are uppercase tiles in drawn squares; words found are lowercase text on ruled rows.

rules.name: The One Pencil Rule
rules.body: Blue marks position and affordance only: where the caret is, what has focus, what is a link, what is about to fire. It is never a fill for decoration or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Theme Mirror Rule
rules.body: Light and dark share the same role names and the same contrast roles. Dark is selected by prefers-color-scheme unless the user has chosen a theme, and by [data-theme='dark'] when they have; an explicit light choice wins over a dark OS setting. Never hard-code a colour outside the custom properties.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is reserved for the masthead and the home headline. Interface text, numerals, controls and found words stay in the sans. Counters and word counts use tabular numerals so they do not jitter.

rules.name: The Tiles and Words Rule
rules.body: Letters you hold are uppercase tiles; words found are lowercase text. Case is applied in CSS (text-transform), never by rewriting the data.

rules.name: The Ruled Paper Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from ink rules and the one-step paper to cell tone change, never from shadow.

dos: Do take every colour from the custom properties so light and dark swap together.
Do keep corners square and separate with 2px (or 4px double / 1px) ink rules.
Do keep serif to the masthead and home headline and use Libre Franklin for everything else.
Do keep Solve the only reversed plate at rest; further actions use the outlined secondary button.
Do show found words lowercase and held letters as uppercase tiles.
Do give any new animation a prefers-reduced-motion off switch and use the --ease-out curve.
Do give new interactive elements and programmatic focus targets the 3px pencil focus-visible outline, and a 2.75rem minimum target for controls.
Do gate hover fills behind @media (hover: hover).
Do put new shared rules in global.css and page-only rules in that page's sheet, reusing the existing custom properties.
donts: Don't add shadows, radii or gradients; the system is flat and square.
Don't use the pencil blue as decoration, heading colour or large fill other than the Solve hover.
Don't reach for pure black or pure white; ink and paper are tinted.
Don't make the partial lists a live region; announce counts through the separate status.
